name: focus-buddy
description: Focus Buddy: a Chrome MV3 companion that helps you start tasks and come back after drifting.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/unit/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run lint:messages && npm run check:manifest && npm run check:secrets && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run check:manifest -- --dist-only && npm run check:secrets -- --dir dist
